summary: Iteration 3 focused retest of the iteration 2 fixes. Backend: a new test_mapestate_iter3.py (8 tests) covers pending, paused, rejected and unknown listings across chat, favorite, enquiry, report, similar and GET, plus approve transitions with exact notification counts, the whitespace chat message and view counting. All 8 pass, and the full suite (46) passes. Frontend (375x667): unavailable-listing and edit-unavailable states, the owner Manage button, the Profile Verified badge, the guest map pin, preview and details flow, and buyer chat from a listing all work. Only low-priority polish issues remain.

minor.issue: If an admin rejects a listing that was already live and then approves it again, notify_saved_searches runs a second time. Saved-search users get duplicate 'new match' alerts for the same listing. Consider sending them only on the first activation, e.g. track a first_published_at field.
There is no status check, so an admin can reject a listing that is already rejected or paused, and a duplicate 'listing_rejected' notification is sent. Low priority.

ui_bugs.component: Property details (owner viewing own pending, paused or rejected listing)
ui_bugs.issue: The favorite heart (details-favorite) still shows. Tapping it calls POST /api/favorites/{id}, which now returns 404 for non-active listings, so the tap silently fails. Hide it for owners or for non-active listings.

issues: The 'Go back' button (property-unavailable-back) is left-aligned at x=24 while the icon and text above it are centered. Add alignSelf: 'center'.
A listing with no images shows an empty grey hero box. Add a placeholder image or icon.
Only red error text is shown. Consider a neutral colour plus a back or 'My Listings' button, like property-unavailable.

action_items: (Low) Hide details-favorite when the viewer is the owner or the listing is not active.
(Low) Avoid resending saved-search alerts when a previously live listing is rejected and then approved again. Add a status guard to admin reject.
critical_code_review_comments: property/[id].tsx: the similar query uses the default retry (3), so it retries 3 times on a 404 for non-active listings. Set retry: false like the main query.

property/[id].tsx: 'isError && !prop' means a listing that is still in cache and later becomes unavailable keeps showing stale details until the cache is cleared. Acceptable, but checking the error status is more robust.
send_message checks for whitespace before _get_conv, so a blank message to an unknown conversation returns 422 instead of 404. Harmless.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_mapestate_api.py (any_pid fixture skips TEST_ listings to fix a race between parallel modules; signup emails are logged to /tmp/iter1_emails.txt for cleanup)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested fixes and regression flows

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ users and listings were created, and all were deleted by email/user id with tests/cleanup_test_data.py. Seed listings and the admin and seed accounts were untouched. Guest and buyer page views raised the views counter on seed listing prop_0e771a3eef4d by about 3, which is expected app behaviour. Two non-seed listings (prop_5fb1cf9611dd, prop_61e8b35b0b15) and test_3ac44a13, test_42738367 and test_ui_04a270 were not created by this run and were left alone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app/backend with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported. Test user emails are appended to /tmp/iter1_emails.txt, /tmp/iter2_emails.txt and /tmp/iter3_emails.txt; pass them to tests/cleanup_test_data.py. The web map pins are Leaflet markers inside an iframe: page.frame_locator('[data-testid="map-view"] iframe').locator('.leaflet-marker-icon'). Use localStorage.clear() and /login to switch users.
rca_of_issue: The original iteration 2 failure in TestEnquiries.test_send_and_received came from the test, not the app. The any_pid fixture took the newest active listing, which could be a TEST_ listing that a parallel module had just approved, so the enquiry went to a test owner instead of the seed agent. Fixed in the fixture.
